title: Entropy-Based Goodness-of-Fit Tests for Generalized $κ$ -Gaussian Distributions
summary: We introduce this class of multivariate Kappa-Gaussian distributions by maximizing a type of Kaniadakis $κ$ entropy subject to certain first- and second-moment constraints. This differs slightly from the approach of Rényi and Tsallis, because the $κ$-entropy arises from a relativity-consistent deformation of the exponential and logarithmic functions and yields a family of distributions whose tails follow a power law, a family that actually reverts to the standard Gaussian distribution as $κ\to 0$.
